headline: Congress approved a joint resolution reappointing John W. McCarter as a citizen regent on the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
what_it_does: This law renews the appointment of John W. McCarter to the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. The Smithsonian is a federal museum and research group, and its board oversees it. Citizen regents are private individuals, not government officials, who serve on this board. The summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 21, 2014.
